tagline: Tyson Foods. We Feed the World Like Family
hero_kpi_rationale: The operating margin reflects the profitability of Tyson Foods' core business. In 2025, it stands at 2.0%, down from 2.6% in 2024, impacted by significant legal expenses ($738M) and impairments. This is a key indicator to assess the operational performance of a consumer staples company.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned from the sale of food products such as beef, pork, and chicken.
kpis.description: Revenue increased due to higher pricing, especially in beef, pork, and prepared segments, but partially offset by higher legal expenses.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between sales and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin declined as livestock, pork, and raw material costs increased significantly.
kpis.signal: Margin pressure due to input cost inflation.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin was 2.0% in 2025 ($1,098M / $54,441M) compared to 2.6% in 2024 ($1,409M / $53,309M), impacted by $738M in legal expenses and $343M in impairments.
kpis.signal: Margin decline in 2025 despite sales growth.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the company.
kpis.description: Approximately 133,000 employees as of September 27, 2025. The company has carried out plant closures and restructurings as part of its network optimization plan.
kpis.signal: Headcount stable, with occasional adjustments through restructurings.

kpis.name: Restructuring Charges
kpis.explanation: Costs related to plant closures and workforce reductions.
kpis.description: $45 million in restructuring charges in 2025 related to site closures and employee separations, as part of the global network optimization plan.

kpis.name: Legal Contingency Accruals
kpis.explanation: Amount set aside to cover potential legal risks.
kpis.description: $738 million in legal contingency accruals in 2025, compared to $182 million in 2024, significantly impacting operating income.

kpis.name: Beef Segment Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Profitability of the beef segment, which suffers from cattle shortage and high costs.
kpis.description: The beef segment's operating margin was negative at -5.2% in 2025, impacted by high cattle costs with an increase of approximately $1,840M in cattle costs.

kpis.name: Chicken Segment Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Profitability of the chicken segment, which benefits from lower feed costs.
kpis.description: The chicken segment reported an operating margin of 8.5% in 2025, driven by a decrease of approximately $340M in poultry feed costs.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company has established a technology committee to monitor cybersecurity risks, but this does not guarantee full protection against attacks.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the meat industry, and changes in these regulations could impact the company's operations.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, and competition could impact sales and pricing.

risks.title: Litigation
risks.score_rationale: Ongoing litigation could have serious consequences on the company's reputation and finances. Legal accruals reached $738M in 2025.

risks.title: Geopolitical
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical events could impact the company's operations, particularly regarding exports and imports.

risks.title: Environmental
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict environmental regulations, and changes in these regulations could impact the company's operations.
